remarks: "The Enclave on Willard" is an association of 14 luxuriously appointed Nantucket Style townhomes in Norwalk close to the Westport border. This home features 4 levels of living. Living Room w/Gas Fireplace and Sliders to Balcony, Dining Room, Kitchen w/Stainless Steel Appliances, 2 Bedrooms including a primary Suite w/ Full Bath and spacious Loft with skylights. The Lower Level offers an extra flex space great for home office , gym or guest space that leads to the outdoor stone patio. Designer Quartz Countertops and Hardwood Floors throughout. 1 Car Garage & 1 Reserved Space. Conveniently located, close to all major shopping, highways & two train stations.  Norwalk's coastal charm and revitalized neighborhoods have become a hotspot for new residents. The city's waterfront developments, diverse dining options, and cultural attractions appeal to those looking for a vibrant community with easy access to the coast.  This property was completed in 2014 and has been beautifully maintained by the original owners. Professionally managed, The Enclave boasts low common charges and is actively and impeccably maintained by the association.
